_provenance.description: Complete contemporaneous single-machine single-build cross-framework comparison. Every cell measured in one sitting on 2026-08-02; no value is carried over from an earlier suite.
_provenance.nuts_protocol: 4000 iterations / 1000 warmup / 4 trials-as-chains, model seed 12345, step_size 0.1, max_tree_depth 10, adapt_step_size ON, adapt_mass_matrix ON, all-dense mass, matched deterministic init (MATCHED_INIT_REAL 1e-6 on the real sites of logistic_regression), cpu, 32 threads, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty.
_provenance.svi_protocol: Plateau-budget: logistic_regression 30000 optimizer steps, robust_regression 2000, n_schools 2000; Adam lr 0.01, 1 particle, init_scale 0.1, AutoNormal, K=200 guide draws, 4 trials, seed 12345. Stan ADVI self-terminates from its converged configuration (grad_samples 10, adapt_iter 200, iter 30000, otherwise CmdStan defaults).

metric_definitions.steady_wall_s_mean: mean of per-trial inference wall over trials 1..3 (trial 0, which carries JIT/warm effects, is dropped)
metric_definitions.n_eff: arviz.ess over post-warmup draws, flattened over every latent scalar, reported [min, median, max]
metric_definitions.PLL: per-chain cumulative predictive log-likelihood, final draw

_provenance.replication: Impulse: 3 replicates per cell; the headline is the replicate whose steady wall is the median, so wall and n_eff/s come from one run. Reference systems: 1 gated run each; their 4 trials provide internal replication.
_provenance.load_gate: 1-minute load average below 12 immediately before each timed run; the observed value and the heaviest non-sbrantq processes are recorded per cell as gate_load1 / gate_contamination.
_provenance.contamination_note: The machine was shared throughout. Another user ran a sustained bazel/clangd build; the gate was honoured for every timed run but bursty clangd activity between gate checks cannot be excluded. Per-cell gate_contamination records what was above 50 percent CPU at gate time.
_provenance.validation_gate: Phase 0(c) hardened adapt-off gate: 5/5 PASS, zero degenerate variables, all 16 variables moved.
_provenance.svi_timing_comparability: Impulse (harness.jl run_svi), NumPyro (numpyro_harness.py run_svi_trial:325-331) and Turing (turing_harness.jl:159-166) all time the FIT ONLY; each draws the K=200 guide samples after the timer stops. Stan cannot be separated: CmdStan's model.variational(draws=K) performs the fit and the K draws in one subprocess call, and stan_harness.py:269-275 times that whole call. Stan's SVI wall is therefore inflated by an unquantified draw-generation component relative to the other three. Stan ADVI is also not the matched Adam optimizer: it runs its own eta adaptation and adaptive SGD with a relative-ELBO stopping test.
_provenance.contamination_detail: The box is shared (192 CPUs). Two other users ran sustained builds during the window. Every timed run passed a 1-minute-load-below-12 gate at start; observed gate loads were 1.2-8.6 across all 48 runs. One cell was affected mid-run: the first attempt at NUTS/noisy_or_topic/Turing.jl (started 04:55:33) hit a third-party build at 05:28:46 that drove the 1-minute load to 195, and after 50 minutes it had not completed its first trial (historical first trial 1888 s). That attempt was KILLED and DISCARDED, not reported. The cell was re-run from a clean gate at 05:55:17 (load 8.59) and completed at 07:36:12. During the retry the sampled 1-minute load had median 6.23 and max 192.88 (transient bursts). The retry's steady wall, 1337.86 s/trial, reproduces the 2026-07-14 value of 1326.33 s/trial to within 0.9 percent, so the bursts did not materially move the number.

ledger_old_to_new._note: old = the value currently feeding paper/figures/baselines_bar_v2_data.json (read-only here). new = this sweep. Metric is median n_eff/s.

phase2_sicm_on_vi_ablation._note: Same driver and methodology as sicm_on_vi_refresh_2026-07-30.json (test/probprog/svi_sicm_benchmark.jl, NUM_STEPS=300, best-of-8 timed repetitions per SICM setting, DEBUG_PROBPROG_DISABLE_SICM toggled with DEBUG_PROBPROG_DISABLE_OPT held false). 3 runs each, load-gated.
